title: Enable -Wredundant-decls.
description:
We don't seem to be getting errors for it, other than the one I just
fixed; add it to the default list of checks.

commits_data.title: Enable -Wredundant-decls.
commits_data.message:
Enable -Wredundant-decls.

Add it to the default list of checks, and fix some errors it causes.
(Sadly, it doesn't work in CLang.)
